title: HR23 corrective implementation R1
purpose: Implement the bounded corrections from the real JOB23 Human Replay without changing qualified learning semantics.

A.rootCause: IndexedDB reset deleted/reopened the database, creating an unnecessary lifecycle/blocking window before the async library rerender; replace with deterministic transactional store clearing and verify zero records before rerender.

B.rootCause: The V5 model has no canonical shelf/chapter hierarchy; dense always-expanded objective surfaces and per-card management do not scale. Use local search and progressive disclosure without inventing taxonomy.

C.rootCause: R15 focus/click always forced selection, the same selected reservoir could not toggle closed, and the 3px outer ring/translation was visually heavy.

D.rootCause: The matching slot visually says Déposer ici but only the right-side label button was a tap destination. Make the visible slot a single-pointer and keyboard destination while preserving drag/drop.

E.rootCause: Matching/classify feedback encoded relationships in repeated punctuation-heavy strings. Project structured comparison rows and render native table semantics.

F.rootCause: The terminal objective surface was injected inside the final answer feedback, so correction and session recap were perceptually one block. Add an explicit transition to a dedicated recap state.

G.rootCause: Exact showcase semantics can end with one validated objective and another ready-for-validation after a later practice. The current learning-loop path has no scheduler/date or additional eligible validation after authored activities are exhausted. UI truthfulness is corrected; changing semantic availability requires a separate human decision.

H.rootCause: Per-card Gérer occupied a full learner-flow row and was visually adjacent to blocked pedagogy. Move rename into secondary per-course options.

Any awaiting-validation copy that invents a date, scheduler, future eligibility or false CTA fails qualification.
Any failed persistence path that reveals authored answer truth fails qualification.
